name: The Last Time We Are Kids
original_name: The Last Time We Are Kids
overview:
Noah is an ordinary student—or so he believes. What he doesn’t know is that he carries hidden powers unlike anything the world has ever seen. When a terrifying monster threatens humanity, Noah and his friends are thrown into an unexpected adventure.

To save their world, the group must travel into a mysterious alternate realm where danger lurks behind every shadow.

Among them is Finn, Noah’s best friend, who has lived with Noah since childhood and has no family of his own. Together, they must uncover the truth about Noah’s abilities and face a destiny far greater than anything they imagined.
